text:
lisa-h: quick heads-up — staging jobrunner logs show env var values being partially redacted for REDWOOD_API_KEY. looks like middle chars are replaced with **** but last 4 chars remain. this is coming through the logs-proxy we send to vendor. anyone else seen this? @mara-s @ajay-m @sophia-r

mara-s: can you paste the snippet so we can see the pattern?

lisa-h: sure, snippet below (sanitized)
```
2026-03-01T14:22:11Z INFO jobrunner starting with env: REDWOOD_API_KEY=sk_test_abc123****def4
2026-03-01T14:22:11Z DEBUG env dump: PATH=/usr/bin, REDWOOD_API_KEY=sk_test_abc123****def4, OTHER=...
```

ajay-m: staging forwarder runs a redact transform in the k8s sidecar before the fluentd -> logs-proxy pipeline. looks like the transform is matching only common patterns and misses some variants. also note: legacy jobrunner occasionally calls os.Environ() which we then serialize in debug logs. debug=true is enabled in the staging job config.

mara-s: that partial mask is not acceptable. immediate risks: vendor could retain last 4 chars, and combined with other leaks might allow identification. mitigation options: 1) disable debug env dumps in staging immediately 2) update redact regex to match full token patterns (e.g. (sk_live|sk_test)[^\\s]+) 3) if any key material might be in external logs, rotate the affected staging keys.

sophia-r: runtime note: production services use KMS-wrapped secrets and don't write plaintext to disk; but staging uses a dev KMS key and some services opt to hydrate envs at process start. we should assume staging key compromise is possible until we audit.

lisa-h: for rotation: can we rotate just the staging key and sync jobs? i don't want to rotate prod unless we find evidence. who can approve staging rotation now?

sophia-r: i approve rotating the staging key now. no prod rotation until audit completes.

mara-s: i'll grep the forwarder retention and vendor buckets — quick check: `grep -R \"REDWOOD_API_KEY\" /var/log/forwarder` and query logs-proxy retention for staging prefix. i'll post results here in ~15m. also will open a minimal PR to ensure redact runs earlier in the pipeline.

ajay-m: opened PR to k8s-sidecar: https://git.redwood.com/r/redwood/sidecar/+refs/PR-849 — adds stricter redact rule and moves transform to pre-serialization step. will request review from @sophia-r.

deploy-bot: [deploy-notice] PR #849 merged -> staging-forwarder, rollout started for namespace `staging` (pods will restart gradually).

mara-s: quick grep result: only staging namespace shows hits, no production prefixes found. vendor retention shows 7 days for staging prefix. i'll request retention reduction + purge for any objects matching staging-logs/* containing `REDWOOD_API_KEY` if found.

lisa-h: thanks. summary action items: 1) disable debug env dumps in staging (ajay) 2) rotate staging API key (mara + vault) 3) PR merged for stricter redaction (ajay) 4) vendor retention purge request (mara) 5) audit to confirm no prod leakage (sophia). i'll file a short incident-note in #incidents with timeline. :thumbsup:

sophia-r: please add the change to KMS IAM: restrict kms:Decrypt to the staging service account(s) and host IP CIDR where possible. also consider adding a vault role condition to require mfa/session tag for any manual unwrap.

lisa-h: will do. thanks everyone. ping me if anything else pops up.
